openings.claim: Keep surname dividers; record household discrepancies and update the behind-desk exception slip whenever books move.
openings.discriminator: Verified mappings and current locations reduce second searches; persistent burst-period delays favor queue congestion.
openings.probe: Record mapping correctness, second searches, queue presence, durations, preparation and reconciliation time.
openings.uncertainty: Household mismatches may not cause second searches; service-time updates and adequate entitlement verification are unproven.

openings.claim: Existing-cart arrivals may retrieve faster than alphabetically shelved holds; shelving has no universal speed advantage.
openings.discriminator: Comparable cohorts retain a cart advantage; disappearance with volume or book size favors sample selection.
openings.probe: Compare naturally occurring cart and shelf pickups, recording volume, sizes, durations and correctness; unmatched comparisons are inconclusive.
openings.uncertainty: Observation preserves constraints; routine retention, comparable cohorts and cart capacity remain unproven.

openings.claim: Use numbered shelf/cart zones and a private reader-to-zone index; keep holds stationary, recording arrivals and removing collected entries.
openings.discriminator: Compare corrected surname placement/current exceptions; equivalent improvement favors that alternative. Persistent searches, congestion, wrong handoffs or excessive preparation/maintenance defeat fixed zones.
openings.probe: Trial a bounded cohort using divider cards; measure locator maintenance, searches, durations, volume and sizes against a comparable window.
openings.uncertainty: Usable zones, capacity, authoritative reader association and preparation plus necessary maintenance within ten clerk-minutes are unknown.

decision: Evidence is synthetic; effects and interview representativeness remain unknown. Bound probes to the existing clerk, two shelves, one cart, private identities and ten preparation clerk-minutes; count reconciliation/maintenance explicitly. Verify entitlement before handoff. Assess whole-window 95% within two minutes and zero wrong-reader handoffs separately from cohort performance.
